content: प्रभृतिः {%f.%} .²1 Beginning, commencement; generally used in this sense as the last member of <ab>Bah.</ab> compound; इन्द्रप्रभृतयो देवाः <ab>&c.</ab> .²2 <ab>Ved.</ab> An oblation. .²3 Throwing or casting (<ab>Ved.</ab>). --{%ind.%} From, ever since, beginning with (with <ab>abl.</ab>); शैशवात् प्रभृति पोषितां प्रियाम् <ls>U. 1. 45</ls>; <ls>Ku. 3. 26</ls>; <ls>R. 2. 38</ls>; अद्यप्रभृति henceforward; ततः प्रभृति, अतः प्रभृति <ab>&c.</ab>
